name: CodexGun
headline: Pilot. Fight. Rescue.
description: Take your ship into orbital arenas, battle bosses and bring the survivors home. A native Rust arcade shooter, ready to play offline on your Mac.
shortDescription: Orbital arenas. Boss battles. Survivors to bring home.
iconAlt: CodexGun spacecraft flying through a cyan-lit orbital arena

features.title: Made for your Mac.
features.description: A native Rust game for Apple Silicon. Download it, install it and make yourself at home.

features.title: Take it offline.
features.description: No browser tab needed. Once installed, the game is playable without an internet connection.

features.title: Help shape what’s next.
features.description: This is a public beta. Play a few levels and share what works — and what needs another look.

releaseSummary: Beta 2 extends Pressure hazards across all five sectors, adds clearer timing and rescue guidance, and keeps developer tools out of the public build.
launchInstruction: Press Enter to start. The menu shows the controls.
compatibilityNote: Compatibility has been tested on Andrew’s Mac; other supported Macs have not yet been verified.
signingNote: The game is signed by Adevious Ltd and notarised by Apple. Notarisation checks software security; it is not a gameplay review.
